_note: Picture cues for the sound designer. frame = round(t*30), 30 fps, 450 frames, 96 BPM (1 beat = 18.75 frames). Per the skill rules, put a hit's peak 1 frame after the picture frame. 'beat' = beat number from frame 0 (null = off the grid). v2 (review fixes): no cue frame was moved. hover_card_1 has no picture event any more (status=removed). New cues are marked status=new_v2.

cues.name: card_land_1
cues.what: card 1 (資料を読む) finishes rising out of its slot (#002 backOut)

cues.name: card_land_2
cues.what: card 2 (植木に水) lands

cues.name: card_land_3
cues.what: card 3 lands

cues.name: card_land_4
cues.what: card 4 lands (already done, checkbox pops in green 0.34 s later)

cues.name: card_land_5
cues.what: card 5 lands

cues.name: card_land_6_all
cues.what: last card lands: the list is complete

cues.name: hover_card_1
cues.what: REMOVED in v2: the cursor no longer hovers 資料を読む. At this frame the cursor only starts moving down from above the top edge (it becomes visible about f64). Drop or greatly soften this sound.

cues.name: cursor_visible
cues.what: cursor tip comes into view at the top edge (soft, optional)

cues.name: hover_select
cues.what: cursor comes straight down from the top edge and enters 植木に水; the card lifts 0.3 s (same frame as v1)

cues.name: select_click
cues.what: click on 植木に水 + ripple inside the card

cues.name: expand_start
cues.what: the same card starts growing into the detail screen (0.6 s)

cues.name: expand_land
cues.what: detail screen settled

cues.name: hint_step_1
cues.what: faint ring pulses around step 1 (next thing to press) until f150; later rings: step 2 f159, step 3 f178, big checkbox f191, back button f214. Very quiet or silent

cues.name: step_check_1
cues.what: click できた: step 1 becomes a check, progress line grows 0.3 s

cues.name: step_check_2
cues.what: step 2 checked

cues.name: step_check_3
cues.what: step 3 checked

cues.name: main_check
cues.what: click on the big checkbox: fills green 0.2 s, check stroke draws 0.25 s (main hit)

cues.name: back_click
cues.what: click ← 一覧へ

cues.name: shrink_start
cues.what: detail shrinks back into its slot (0.6 s)

cues.name: count_grow
cues.what: the 完了 counter grows to 1.6x (to f246) before the digit rolls; shrinks back f258-f269

cues.name: shrink_land
cues.what: card docks in the list, now checked

cues.name: count_roll
cues.what: 完了 2 → 3: digit rolls up (0.32 s)

cues.name: count_lock
cues.what: number settles at 3: it pops 1.3 -> 1 (0.3 s) and a thin ring spreads from it (0.5 s) — v2 makes this a clearer hit

cues.name: portal_start
cues.what: green ring grows out of the checked card's checkbox (1.15 s)

cues.name: portal_end
cues.what: weekly view fully revealed

cues.name: week_heading_in
cues.what: 今週の完了 and the day labels appear after the ring has fully opened (0.25 s)

cues.name: bar_1
cues.what: bar 月 starts rising (each 0.5 s, value pops 0.34 s later)

cues.name: bar_2
cues.what: bar 火

cues.name: bar_3
cues.what: bar 水

cues.name: bar_4
cues.what: bar 木

cues.name: bar_5
cues.what: bar 金

cues.name: bar_6
cues.what: bar 土 (10.625 = beat 17)

cues.name: bar_today
cues.what: today's bar (dark green, tallest) starts rising

cues.name: bar_today_land
cues.what: today's bar settles: graph complete

cues.name: bars_exit
cues.what: values vanish, bars sink into the baseline left to right (to 12.19 s)

cues.name: title_line
cues.what: baseline stretches into the title rule (beat 19 = 11.875, frame 356)

cues.name: title_rise
cues.what: ひとつずつ rises out from behind the rule

cues.name: title_land
cues.what: title visually lands (quintic ease-out is 97% there; fully still at 12.875 s / f386)

cues.name: tagline_land
cues.what: 今日のことを、ひとつずつ。 has dropped into place

cues.name: icon_pop
cues.what: app icon with check pops in (peak about 0.2 s later, f400)

cues.name: end_hold
cues.what: everything is still until the end (frame 449)
